entities.name: Melchor de Navarra, Duke of Palata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Melchor de Navarra y Rocafull, jure uxoris Duke of Palata, Prince of Massalubrense was a Spanish politician. From November 20, 1681 to August 15, 1689 he was viceroy of Peru.
